name: The Three Weathers
note: E1 vertical-slice test route (provisional). Tropical heat -> monsoon coast -> fog -> grey cold -> pack ice, about 3,430 km = 230 real minutes at the reference speed. Checkpoints are DEBUG jumps: they place the ship and set the clock; they never accelerate time.

checkpoints.name: Kettle dawn squall
checkpoints.why: Warm rain squall at first light. The reference tropical look.

checkpoints.name: Kettle edge, noon
checkpoints.why: Clear noon, 9 km sight, 60 km before the Sunward border. The calm baseline.

checkpoints.name: Sunward, monsoon coast
checkpoints.why: Cooler water than Kettle, light wind: the monsoon turning season. Sea colour and swell change.

checkpoints.name: Fogbound dawn
checkpoints.why: Sight drops to about half a kilometre. Fog bell and pilotage take over.

checkpoints.name: Grey Landing, Herald Swell
checkpoints.why: Heavy long swell with no wind yet. The gale (checkpoint 6) arrives one game day later. This is the warning.

checkpoints.name: Grey Landing, the gale
checkpoints.why: The gale the swell promised, 15 real minutes later.

checkpoints.name: Ice Edge
checkpoints.why: Sea ice and freezing air at the north rim. The end of the slice.
